plugin.name: Dragonfall_Level_Remort
plugin.author: Dragonfall
plugin.purpose: Level a defined remort class to 80 via setclass
plugin.description:
Dragonfall — remort class leveler (immortal functional test)
dfremort [player] [class] [level] dfconfig char <name> dfconfig class <Sor|Ass|Kni|Nec|Mon> dfconfig level <1-80> dfshow
Examples: dfremort dfremort Testchar Kni 80 dfremort Testchar Sorcerer dfconfig char Testchar
Classes: Sor/Sorcerer Ass/Assassin Kni/Knight Nec/Necromancer Mon/Monk

muclient.script:
-- Canonical who_name values from src/const.c remort_table[]. local REMORT = { sor = "Sor", sorcerer = "Sor", ass = "Ass", assassin = "Ass", kni = "Kni", knight = "Kni", nec = "Nec", necromancer = "Nec", mon = "Mon", monk = "Mon", }
local DEFAULT_CHAR = "Testchar" local DEFAULT_CLASS = "Sor" local DEFAULT_LEVEL = 80 local MIN_LEVEL = 1 local MAX_LEVEL = 80 -- just below LEVEL_HERO (81)
local function say(msg) ColourNote("mediumorchid", "", "[dfremort] ", "white", "", msg) end
local function fail(msg) ColourNote("red", "", "[dfremort] ", "white", "", msg) end
local function trim(s) return (string.gsub(tostring(s or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end
local function split_words(s) local out = {} for w in string.gmatch(trim(s), "%S+") do out[#out + 1] = w end return out end
local function valid_name(s) return string.match(s, "^[%a][%a%d_]*$") ~= nil end
function NormalizeRemort(token) if not token or token == "" then return nil end return REMORT[string.lower(token)] end
local function get_char() local v = trim(GetVariable("char") or "") if v ~= "" then return v end return DEFAULT_CHAR end
local function get_class() local v = NormalizeRemort(GetVariable("class") or "") if v then return v end return DEFAULT_CLASS end
local function get_level() local n = tonumber(GetVariable("level")) if n and n >= MIN_LEVEL and n <= MAX_LEVEL then return math.floor(n) end return DEFAULT_LEVEL end
function ShowUsage() say("usage: dfremort [player] [class] [level]") Note(" classes: Sor Ass Kni Nec Mon (full names also accepted)") Note(" defaults: char=" .. get_char() .. " class=" .. get_class() .. " level=" .. tostring(get_level())) Note(" config: dfconfig char <name> | class <abbr> | level <n>") Note(" show: dfshow") Note(" sends: setclass <player> <class> <level> then force <player> save") Note(" requires: immortal trust 90 (setclass)") end
function DoLevelRemort(player, class_who, level) if not valid_name(player) then fail("bad player name '" .. tostring(player) .. "' (letters/digits/underscore)") return end if not class_who then fail("unknown remort class (want Sor Ass Kni Nec Mon)") return end level = tonumber(level) if not level or level < MIN_LEVEL or level > MAX_LEVEL then fail("level must be " .. MIN_LEVEL .. "–" .. MAX_LEVEL) return end level = math.floor(level)
local cmd = string.format("setclass %s %s %d", player, class_who, level) say(cmd) Send(cmd) Send(string.format("force %s save", player)) end
function OnDfRemort(name, line, wildcards) local rest = trim(wildcards[1] or "") if rest == "help" or rest == "?" or rest == "-h" or rest == "--help" then ShowUsage() return end
local w = split_words(rest) local player, class_who, level = get_char(), get_class(), get_level()
if #w == 0 then -- defaults elseif #w == 1 then local as_class = NormalizeRemort(w[1]) local as_level = tonumber(w[1]) if as_class then class_who = as_class elseif as_level then level = as_level else player = w[1] end elseif #w == 2 then if NormalizeRemort(w[1]) and tonumber(w[2]) then class_who, level = NormalizeRemort(w[1]), tonumber(w[2]) elseif tonumber(w[2]) then player, level = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) else player, class_who = w[1], NormalizeRemort(w[2]) or class_who if not NormalizeRemort(w[2]) then fail("unknown remort class '" .. w[2] .. "'") return end end elseif #w >= 3 then player = w[1] class_who = NormalizeRemort(w[2]) level = tonumber(w[3]) if not class_who then fail("unknown remort class '" .. w[2] .. "'") return end end
DoLevelRemort(player, class_who, level) end
function OnDfConfig(name, line, wildcards) local w = split_words(wildcards[1] or "") if #w == 0 then OnDfShow() return end
local key = string.lower(w[1]) local val = w[2] if key == "char" or key == "name" or key == "player" then if not val or not valid_name(val) then fail("dfconfig char <PlayerName>") return end SetVariable("char", val) say("char = " .. val) elseif key == "class" then local who = NormalizeRemort(val) if not who then -- mortal plugin owns Mag/Cle/... — ignore unknown here return end SetVariable("class", who) say("class = " .. who) elseif key == "level" then local n = tonumber(val) if not n or n < MIN_LEVEL or n > MAX_LEVEL then fail("dfconfig level <" .. MIN_LEVEL .. "-" .. MAX_LEVEL .. ">") return end SetVariable("level", tostring(math.floor(n))) say("level = " .. tostring(math.floor(n))) else return end end
function OnDfShow() say("char=" .. get_char() .. " class=" .. get_class() .. " level=" .. tostring(get_level()) .. " (remort → setclass)") end
function OnPluginInstall() if trim(GetVariable("char") or "") == "" then SetVariable("char", DEFAULT_CHAR) end if not NormalizeRemort(GetVariable("class") or "") then SetVariable("class", DEFAULT_CLASS) else SetVariable("class", NormalizeRemort(GetVariable("class"))) end if not tonumber(GetVariable("level")) then SetVariable("level", tostring(DEFAULT_LEVEL)) end say("loaded — dfremort [player] [class] [level] (dfshow for defaults)") end
